subject: AuroraBio - backup purge & log retention carveout negotiation
messages:
From: Olivia James <olivia.james@aurorabio.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mateo Sanchez <mateo.sanchez@aurorabio.com>, DevOps Team <devops@aurorabio.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify backup purge timing + log retention carveout request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the run-through on Friday. We reviewed the DPA draft and the proposed backup purge cadence. AuroraBio's compliance team has two asks before we can sign:

1) A temporary carveout for application logs: we require 24 months of log retention for forensic needs (our default is 18 months).
2) A certificate of deletion for backups containing PII once the purge runs — Aurora wants a signed acknowledgement per purge quarter.

We understand Redwood's standard purge cadence is 90 days for hot backups and 365 days for cold snapshots. Can you confirm whether you can: (a) hold an immutable copy for an additional 6 months strictly for forensic logs, and (b) provide a quarterly deletion certificate (PDF) after each purge that lists snapshot IDs removed?

Attaching our internal retention matrix for reference.

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of IT Compliance, AuroraBio

Attachment: aurorabio_requested_retention_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia James <olivia.james@aurorabio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify backup purge timing + log retention carveout request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear asks and the matrix. Short answers up front: we can accommodate a scoped carveout for log artifacts and we can produce deletion attestations, but both have operational and cost implications we should align on.

Details / proposal:
- Scoped retention: Redwood can create a `log-retain` tag that preserves parsed application logs (index + compressed log blobs) for an extra 6 months beyond your snapshot TTL. This would be a billed add-on and limited to logs with a retention flag; other backup artifacts would follow standard cadence.
- Deletion certificate: we can generate a signed PDF per purge run that enumerates snapshot IDs purged, timestamp, and the shard/region. Standard delivery would be via S3-locked bucket with read-only link; we can also upload to your DocuSign/contract portal if needed.

Operational questions:
- Do you need the `log-retain` artifact to be held in-region only (us-east-1) or cross-region? Cross-region copies increase cost and SLA surface area.
- What is the expected monthly volume of retained log data? Our engineering team needs an estimate to size retention queues.

I'll loop Marissa and Aditya for implementation and legal alignment. If agreeable, we can draft an addendum to the DPA that defines the carveout scope, billing line, and deletion attestation cadence.

Best,
Kimberly
Senior Manager, Customer Trust — Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Mateo Sanchez <mateo.sanchez@aurorabio.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia James <olivia.james@aurorabio.com>, DevOps Team <devops@aurorabio.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 08:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify backup purge timing + log retention carveout request

Kimberly — thanks. A few clarifications from legal:
- The deletion certificate should be signed by an authorized Redwood representative and include an auditable hash of the manifest file.
- We require a 30-day notice before the first purge that triggers deletion of any data subject to the carveout so we can reconcile customer inquiries.
- Cross-border: if any retained log copies are outside the US, we need the subprocessor list for those cloud regions; Aurora will not accept Australian or other APAC subprocessor storage for regulated datasets.

On volume: estimated ~1.2 TB/month of parsed app logs for the services using Redwood.

Mateo
Senior Counsel, AuroraBio

Date: Wed, 01 Aug 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify backup purge timing + log retention carveout request

Hi all — operational reply and cost estimate from the Redwood side.

What we can do (implementation plan):
- Create a dedicated retention class `aurorabio-log-retain` scoped to your account for 24 months. This will be applied at ingestion time via routing rules; existing snapshots can be remediated via a one-time tagging job.
- Maintain retained artifacts in us-east-1 only (per your cross-border constraint).
- Generate a quarterly deletion certificate: signed PDF + SHA256 manifest listing purged snapshot IDs, timestamp, and purged byte counts. Delivery: S3 link + HubSpot upload.

Cost impact: approx $0.045 / GB-month for the additional retention class (estimated monthly bill ~ $54 for 1.2 TB). One-time remediation job to tag historical logs: one-time fee of $2,200.

Controls & audit: we will add the `retention` entries to your audit logs, and a short runbook so Aurora's DevOps can reconcile before purge. We can provide a 30-day pre-purge notification webhook that posts to your internal endpoint or emails a distribution list.

Next steps: if Aurora confirms in writing we will: (1) draft a DPA addendum with the carveout and billing language; (2) schedule the remediation tagging job; (3) configure the quarterly cert pipeline.

Marissa
Director, Trust & Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: aurorabio_backup_matrix_v2.xlsx (implementation mapping)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia James <olivia.james@aurorabio.com>, Mateo Sanchez <mateo.sanchez@aurorabio.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Aug 2028 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify backup purge timing + log retention carveout request

Olivia / Mateo — closing note from product/ops leadership. Thanks for the patience while we scoped impact.

We will proceed per Marissa's plan: 24-mo scoped retention for parsed logs, US-only storage, quarterly signed deletion certificates with manifest hashes, and a 30-day pre-purge notification. Attached is the DPA addendum we were able to finalize with legal; please sign and return when ready.

Operationally, we will not backdate retention beyond the one-time remediation tag job (so historical logs older than your requested window remain subject to normal TTL unless tagged). If Aurora needs escrow or immutable snapshot escrow beyond this (for example for litigation hold), let's discuss an escrow arrangement or Private deployment option.

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing.
Aditya
Head of Trust & Platform Partnerships — Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_addendum_signed_AuroraBio.pdf (signed draft)
